findings.finding: T07 frozen scope is a human-context selector and excludes animal behavior. Wording could imply an existing pet-goal/AI interface or silently assign pet arbitration to an approved task.
findings.required_disposition: Preserve simple-control/priority language; species and T31 own pet/job arbitration; shared-selector changes use the existing scope/change-request process.

findings.finding: Every species attacking in every region band would overstate the user instruction and could force impossible locomotion or extra staging/equipment just to populate a matrix.
findings.required_disposition: Use explicit regional applicability and useful safe alternatives while preserving every species actual attack through applicable progression; no forced owl underwater combat or new equipment solely for table completeness.
